paragraphs: Ilufisa gave Rabbi Shimon bar Abba tithe and said, “It has been duly prepared.” He asked Rabbi Yochanan, who told him, “Our brother Ilufisa is trustworthy,” Jerusalem Talmud, Terumot, chapter 1, end of halakhah 1.
